summary: Wired Pi session extension binding into the agent server (call session.bindExtensions with mode 'json' when GIZMO_PI_WEB=1), added a 'session.reload' RPC, exposed reloadSession on the AgentClient (WebSocket, Fake, and test fakes), and added a 'Reload runtime' button in AgentSettings that calls a new reloadRuntime method on AgentStore.
decisions: Only call session.bindExtensions when process.env.GIZMO_PI_WEB === '1', passing mode 'json' and an onError logger that prints extensionPath and error.
Add a 'session.reload' RPC and surface it via reloadSession on WebSocketAgentClient, FakeAgentClient, and the InvalidEventClient test fake to satisfy the AgentClient interface.
Add a runtimeReloading boolean state on AgentStore and a reloadRuntime() method that calls client.reloadSession, handling success/error and clearing the flag in finally.
Expose a 'Reload runtime' Button in AgentSettings disabled when no session, while runtimeReloading, or while sessionState is 'streaming'.
errors: svelte-check failed: InvalidEventClient test fake in apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/AgentStore.test.ts was missing the new reloadSession method required by the AgentClient interface; resolved by adding a no-op async reloadSession() to the fake.

Server crash observed in logs originating from a stale git-info extension timer (Timeout._onTimeout in extensions/git-info/index.ts) firing after the process restarted, triggering run() in the extension runner; investigated via .pi/agent-server.log tail but not fixed in this segment.
